justification: The assessment returned verdict VALID, so by the rubric it is MISSED regardless of its reasoning. Notably it came within reach of the ground-truth flaw (the false trichotomy for subgroups of S_7 generated by two 7-cycles) at step 0025: it observed that 'S_7' should read 'A_7' and even noted 7-cycles are even, but explicitly dismissed the discrepancy as a cosmetic labeling slip on the grounds that the alternative is discarded by an order argument (2520 or 5040 both exceed 168). That dismissal is itself the gap the ground truth identifies -- A_7 is a genuinely realizable case omitted from the enumeration -- yet the assessment still concluded the proof VALID and left flawed_step and counterexample empty.
